title: Endpoint Performance Toolkit — per-endpoint & per-model microdashboard specs
creator: Anika Rao
description: Design and deliver a compact, embeddable 'microdashboard' canvas for per-endpoint and per-model views in Redwood Console. These microdashboards will power the route detail page, model card flyouts, and embeddable widgets for runbooks. Focus is on latency/throughput/token metrics, fast comparisons across versions, and clear signal for regressions. Deliverables: Figma prototype, chart spec sheet, accessibility notes, dev handoff frames.
user_stories: As an SRE I want to see p50/p95/p99 latency and throughput at a glance so I can triage regressions quickly.
As a product engineer I want to compare token usage per-request across model versions to optimize cost/quality trade-offs.
As an on-call engineer I need a compact heatmap for sequence-length vs latency to understand performance cliffs at high seq lengths.
layout_spec: Canvas size: adaptive 940px wide for route-detail panel; embeddable variant at 420px wide.
Top row: title + model/version selector + quick timeframe (1h/24h/7d) + compare toggle.
Middle row: left: latency timeline (line + percentile bands). Middle: throughput bar (requests/min) with success/error stacked. Right: token-cost sparkline + avg tokens/request metric.
Bottom row: compact distribution (histogram with percentile markers) and a small sequence-length vs p95 heatmap. Each chart must have export CSV and open-in-insights links.
Interaction: hover shows per-point tooltip, click on percentile in legend toggles series, compare toggle overlays baseline model/version with translucent colors.
chart_specs: Latency timeline: primary metric p50/p95/p99 plotted as lines; shaded area for p95-p99. X-axis: time (auto buckets: 1m for 1h, 5m for 24h, 1h for 7d). Y-axis: ms (log-scale optional toggle). Tooltip: sample count, median, 95th, 99th, error-rate, top-5 user-agents.
Throughput chart: stacked bar per-minute showing success / client-error / server-error. Y-axis: requests/min. Include rate-per-token baseline line when compare enabled.
Token usage sparkline: area chart of tokens/request average; hover shows median and 90th. Include cost-per-1k-tokens overlay when billing SKU is available.
Latency distribution: normalized histogram (bucket size configurable) with vertical lines for p50/p95/p99. Include option to switch to violin plot for smoother distribution view.

Sequence-length heatmap: X-axis sequence-length buckets (0-64,65-128,129-256,257-512,513-1024,1025+) ; Y-axis percentile (p50/p95/p99); color intensity = median latency. Tooltip: sample count and sample example prompt id.
Model-compare overlay: when two versions selected, use colorblind-safe palettes, overlay with 50% opacity and clear legend with delta markers for p95 and avg tokens.
SLO overlay: optional dashed horizontal line for configured latency SLO and shaded 'alert' bands when breached for >5% of requests in a window.
Annotation support: UI should allow adding pinned annotations (deploys, config changes) which appear as vertical lines with editable titles.
accessibility_notes: All color palettes must meet WCAG contrast 4.5:1 for core data lines against background.
Provide non-color encodings (patterned fills) for charts where color alone conveys error states.
Keyboard focus: chart elements (legend items, compare toggle, timeframe) must be navigable and announce state via ARIA live regions.
Tooltips must be accessible via keyboard (focusable) and provide concise alt-text for screen readers.
acceptance_criteria: Figma prototype demonstrates all layout variants (full route panel, compact embeddable) with working interactions for compare + annotations.
Chart spec doc includes bucketization rules, default aggregation windows, and fallbacks for sparse data (<100 samples).
Design tokens provided for colorblind-safe palette and semantic tokens (success, error, baseline, highlight).
Developer handoff frames contain all export-ready assets and example mock CSVs for e2e integration tests.
UX reviewed by PM (Lena Ortiz) and SRE lead (Akash Gopal), with comments addressed.
design_assets: Figma frame names: Endpoint Toolkit / Route Panel / Embeddable Widget / Heatmap Frame
decisions: Use time-bucket strategy aligned with Console Insights to simplify backend aggregation (1m/5m/1h).
Expose log-scale for latency only as optional toggle — default is linear to avoid misinterpretation by PMs.
Embed small compare overlays rather than side-by-side charts to save vertical space in narrow panels.
Do not include raw token-text in tooltips due to PII risk; link to request explorer for full payload when permitted.
